svg.aria-label: Tristan da Cunha four island areas and nine real locations
svg.metadata: Target islands, no invented coastlines: OpenStreetMap boundary relations 3672294 (Tristan da Cunha), 1974295 (Inaccessible Island), 3672300 (Nightingale Islands), and 3672293 (Gough Island), extracted as GeoJSON from missinglink/osm-boundaries at commit 4b9b610f25ec3477683c8a203ed486ecdb8c9f9f, https://github.com/missinglink/osm-boundaries . Geography © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright . 2026-11-15 verification. WGS84/CRS84; main 1200x760 local-equirectangular-fit-v1. Gough is a detached inset at different scale; it is NOT connected to the other islands. All data-x, data-y are projected from named actual latitude/longitude and label coordinates represent visual-only offsets.
